question: Does Openworld publish a numeric egress bandwidth or byte allowance with a unit on its own pages?
why: The vendor FAQ and landing page give no egress byte or rate number. The operator stated 'Bandwidth: 50GB/week, once you hit the limit it will throttle to 1mbps' in a LowEndTalk forum post, not on a vendor-owned page, so it is not used as a first-party documented value.
